ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Sustainable Life Cycle Design and Research I is an asynchronous online course and uses Compass (Blackboard). Enrollment is this course section is restricted to non-residential, nondegree, undergraduate students only. Prerequisite: Sustainable life Cycle Design and Research I (ARTD 499, SP 13, 1st 8-week course) or permission of the instructor.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $380.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $347.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
